row.team_price_text: Team: $39/mo flat billed annually ($46 monthly), 3 login seats included
row.evidence: UptimeRobot's Enterprise page lists 'SSO / SAML (Enterprise)', but neither the pricing page, the help centre nor the v3 API reference documents SCIM or any team-member provisioning endpoint.
row.notes: No SCIM, set by absence across the pricing page (and pricing.md), Enterprise page, help-centre collections, v3 OpenAPI spec, llms.txt and sitemap. SSO/SAML is Enterprise only (quote-based, 'Starting price: $1,200 per year'). Plans are flat per account, priced by monitor count: Solo $12/mo (single user, no login seats), Team $39/mo with 3 login seats, Scale from $79/mo with 5; extra login seats $15/mo each billed annually. Team members are invited by email from the Team Members page. The v3 API covers monitors, incidents, status pages and alert contacts; the only user call is GET /user/me. Okta OIN app is SWA-only (2015).

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint or provisioning guide on any UptimeRobot page searched; set by absence. The Enterprise page names SSO/SAML and audit logs but not SCIM.

capabilities.notes: False means absent from the v3 OpenAPI spec, which has no team or member endpoints.

rate_limits.text: Free plan 10 req/min; paid plans monitor limit x 2 req/min, max 5000 req/min

user_api.notes: The REST API (all plans, including Free) manages monitors, incidents, status pages, maintenance windows and alert contacts; team members are managed only in the dashboard.

fallbacks.notes: Team members are added by email invitation from the dashboard's Team Members page.
